text:
Jamie (CEO): All-hands Monday 11:00am PT — plan for ~40m. Agenda: short exec status (10m), Dedicated GA callouts (10m), incident postmortem highlight (5m), policy update on customer data egress (5m), 10m live Q&A. Please add 1-2 questions here or use the Q/A short form: https://tiny.redwood/ah-qa.

Nora (People Ops): Calendar invite sent to everyone. Reminder set for 10:45am. Hybrid room details and dial-in are in the invite.

Maya (Product): For Dedicated GA Ill show the go-to-customer checklist and timing. Need confirmation from Marketing for the customer quote we'll mention.

Ben (Marketing): I can confirm one quote from Acero by EOD today. Will also prepare the 30s customer highlight clip.

Omar (Eng-SRE): Quick heads-up: last week's 3min cache-priming outage is in the postmortem. I'll cover the root cause and the short-term mitigation we applied. Full postmortem link will be in the notes.

Priya (Security): Policy note: small change to egress approvals for Dedicated customers moving data to third-party analytics. We'll present the summary and link to the draft policy for feedback. Long form policy: https://internal.redwood/policies/egress-guidelines-dedicated.

scheduler-bot: Event created by Nora: "All-Hands Exec + Dedicated GA Callouts" Monday 11:00am PT.

Jamie (CEO): Please file questions by 6pm today. We'll answer the top live and follow up on the rest in the notes. React with :thumbsup: to bump a question.

[Post-call] Jamie (CEO): Recording uploaded: https://recordings.redwood.com/ah-1998001234. TL;DR: exec, product, incident, policy, actions below.
- Exec: focus on three bets this quarter: (1) reliability (SLOs + canaries), (2) unit cost optimization, (3) making Dedicated onboarding <3 days for standard customers.
- Dedicated GA: launch window set for next month. Customer-facing checklist published: https://internal.redwood/dedicated/ga-checklist. Marketing will publish the enablement kit.
- Incident: outage root cause was a cache warming race under high burst traffic; mitigation adds a short quiesce + health-check gate. Postmortem: https://incidents.redwood/pm-2026-08-cache-warm.
- Policy: egress approval now requires an egress review ticket for any third-party analytic integration; default approval for internal analytics remains. Feedback requested via the policy doc comments.
- Actions: Eng-SRE to push the cache-quiesce fix to stable by EOW; Product + Marketing to finalize GA messaging and customer quote; Security to collect feedback and publish final policy; People Ops to share slides and recording.

Maya (Product): GA checklist link in slides: https://drive.redwood.com/ah/1998001234/slides. Thanks to Eng-Platform + SRE for the migration checklist work.

Omar (Eng-SRE): Fix in staging; opening PRs for stable backport. Tagging @Maya and @Priya for reviews.

Priya (Security): Will consolidate feedback and publish the policy final by next Wednesday.

Ben (Marketing): Sharing draft customer clip to the team channel by EOD. Need Product sign-off.

Nora (People Ops): Notes, slides, and recording pinned in #all-hands. If you asked a question live and we missed it, drop it here and we'll follow up. :white_check_mark:

Jamie (CEO): Great job everyone. Short, focused call. If any team needs a deeper follow-up session (especially around migration timing or policy exceptions), propose a 30m follow-up and tag the relevant owners.
